notes: EXAMPLE, NOT AUTHORITATIVE. The real legacy<->V2 field mapping is being determined separately; this file exists so the harness has a runnable input and so the mapping shape is documented against a real family. Paths are read against the row objects components/review/table-configs/material-contracts.config.js selectRows() returns, on both sides.

fields.notes: Canonical contract-type bucket. Null on evidence-only rows, which is why label is also part of the row key.
Deliberately text, not number: the column legitimately holds 'Any' and non-dollar gates alongside dollar figures, so numeric folding would be unsound here.
The clause text shown in the Evidence column. quote kind, so a shorter V2 string is reported as V2_LOSS rather than a bare disagreement.
Absent on live rows; VALIDATED_NOT_SERVED on dark-preview rows. Present-on-one-side-only is reported, never skipped.
